text:
sasha: heads-up — staging linkcheck failed after the docs deploy. docusaurus linkcheck shows a broken fragment for /guides/deploy/#runtime-config/ (404). looks like trailing-slash + anchor mismatch.

docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken fragment found during preview build. see CI job: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/7623 (snippet below).

sam: grabbing logs now, quick paste:
```
ERROR: Broken fragment: /guides/deploy/#runtime-config/ -> status 200 but fragment not found
Request URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploy/#runtime-config/
Link text: "runtime config"
```

maria: probable causes: 1) header slug changed during an MDX/remark upgrade, 2) link has an extra trailing slash causing the check to normalize differently, or 3) explicit frontmatter/id was removed. quick fixes: either update the link to the canonical slug or add an explicit id on the heading.

maria: example markdown fix (option A - add explicit id):
```
### Runtime config {#runtime-config}
```
or (option B - normalize the link):
```
[runtime config](/guides/deploy#runtime-config)
```

matthew: other option is to flip docusaurus "trailingSlash" behavior or add a redirect rule in site config. but I'd prefer fixing the source link or adding the explicit heading id so it's robust across tooling changes.

sam: i'll open a tiny docs PR that adds the explicit id to the heading and updates the one bad link to the non-trailing-slash variant. will run `npx docusaurus linkcheck` locally before pushing.

sam: local linkcheck output (after adding id locally):
```
Running linkcheck... done. 0 broken fragments.
```

sasha: awesome — drop the PR link here when ready. also ping @matthew for a quick config sanity check if we decide to change trailingSlash later.

sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3245 — title: "docs: normalize deploy guide anchor + add explicit id". small delta, adds `{#runtime-config}` and replaces `/guides/deploy/#runtime-config/` -> `/guides/deploy#runtime-config`.

matthew: looked — lgtm from infra side. no config changes required. if we see more anchor flakiness we can discuss adding a remark plugin to pin slugs.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-3245--docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploy (linkcheck passed on the PR preview).

sasha: perfect, thanks everyone. leaving this open until the PR is merged and the next staging deploy is clean. :thumbsup:

sam: merging once CI finishes. will follow up if anything else pops up.
